content: {"like": ["The first Child’s Play was scary and set a high standard for sequels.", "Curse of Chucky brought back the scare factor.", "Jennifer Tilly’s performance was great as always.", "Fiona Dourif’s acting and character were enjoyable."], "dislike": ["Seed and Bride were cheesy and corny.", "The overt gore and subpar acting by some cast members were bad.", "The storyline was a letdown.", "Andy Barkley was underutilized and only appeared for about 20 minutes.", "The plot with multiple Chuckys and stupid jokes made the movie feel like Seed and Bride.", "Overall the film was disappointing."]}
